- Raised the minimum supported Qt 5 version to 5.13, matching the oldest retained CI
  build, and removed the Qt 5.9 build job
  (related to #3752)

- Added Ubuntu 27.04 Tenacious T-Rex to the Qt6 Launchpad build script
- Line ending markers (¶) in the note editor now use the Whitespace marker color of the
  editor color scheme, like the markers for spaces and tabs
  (for #3840)
- Added tag support to the Nextcloud Deck dialog
  (for #3834)
  - Tags of the cards are shown as colored pills in the new Tags column of the card list,
    and the search also finds cards by their tags
  - The tags of a card are shown as colored chips in the card editor and can be removed
    with a click
  - Tags can be added via the Add tag button or Ctrl + T, which opens a searchable
    tag list of the board
  - New tags can be created right from the tag list, with a choice of the Deck tag colors
- The Note tags panel got a new look
  (for #3841)
  - Tags are shown as rounded chips in their tag color, and can be removed via their ✕ button
  - Clicking a tag shows all notes with that tag in the Tags panel
  - Tags wrap onto more lines instead of needing a horizontal scrollbar
  - Add tag opens a searchable list of all tags, nested tags are shown with their parent tags,
    tags can be toggled and new tags can be created right from the list
  - With multiple notes selected, tags that are only on some of the notes are shown faded
    with a dashed border, and adding them in the tag list adds them to all selected notes

- Fixed PDF exports adding extra margins beyond those selected in page setup,
  for both single notes and selected notes
  (for #3837)
- Fixed unsafe media and attachment paths being followed when copying, moving, or
  exporting notes (thank you, r3vpwnx)
  (for GHSA-fmqx-8x8h-gf76)
- Hardened file and folder names from notes, imports, the local trash and remote data, so they
  can no longer lead to files outside their folders being read, written or deleted
  (for #3836)
  - The Files navigation panel ignores media and attachment links that escape their folders
  - Note files, including notes created from wiki links or server data, are never stored outside
    the note folder
  - The Joplin import skips folder names and resource file extensions that point outside
    their folders
  - Trashed notes, and scripts from the script repository, are only used with plain file names
  - Exporting a note as HTML with embedded images only embeds files that are real images
  - Path-containment checks resolve symlinks while preserving symlinked root directories
  - Filename cleanup preserves new titles containing path punctuation without touching files
    at their original, unsafe paths
  - Media and attachment transfers reject symlink escapes while preserving links within
    their folders
  - Image filename extensions alone are not trusted when exporting HTML; extensionless
    images and long-header SVGs remain supported
  - Joplin imports reject folder and resource symlinks that escape the import or note folder
  - Local trash restoration rejects symlink destinations outside the note folder
  - Script installation and updates reject symlink escapes from the script repository
  - Creating notes from wiki links rejects subfolder symlinks that escape the note folder
- The 26.11.0 release of
  QOwnNotes for Nextcloud adds bookmark management
  - A Bookmarks dialog lists bookmarks from notes tagged bookmarks or named Bookmarks,
    compatible with QOwnNotes Desktop's Web Companion bookmarks and QOwnNotes Android bookmarks
  - Search and filter bookmarks by tags, open, edit or delete them, with changes saved to all
    bookmark notes containing them; editing includes a Markdown preview
  - Fixed notes failing to load with status code 423 when the note folder doesn't exist yet

26.10.9
- The 26.10.3 release of
  QOwnNotes for Nextcloud adds more editor actions
  to the web interface
  - Link dialog with web page title fetching and a searchable Link to note tab, inserting
    relative note links compatible with QOwnNotes Desktop (Ctrl+L, or Ctrl+Shift+L for note links)
  - Insert inline code or fenced code blocks, including wrapping selected text (Ctrl+Shift+C)
  - Toggle checkbox list formatting on the current line or selected lines, preserving list markers
    and indentation (Alt+L)
  - These actions are also available in the note's "…" menu; use Cmd instead of Ctrl on macOS
- Fixed saved task list selections being cleared when accepting settings without changes
  (for #3798)
- Added an optional Linux Qt6 CMake build with KDE Frameworks application metadata
  (QON_KDE_INTEGRATION), a qownnotes-qt6-kde Nix flake package, and build diagnostics
  (for #3796)
  - just build / just nix-build now select the KDE variant on Linux; plain Qt6 and
    macOS builds remain available without KDE dependencies
  - KDE builds initialize KCrash for GUI startup, with DrKonqi support when the reporter
    and system crash-reporting setup are available
  - KDE builds use native Plasma global shortcuts when its service is available, preserving
    Plasma-side changes and retaining the portal/QHotkey backends on other desktops
  - All actions are offered in the Plasma shortcut settings, so global shortcuts can also
    be assigned there, and they are shown with their menu path (e.g. Note → New note)
  - KDE builds send desktop notifications that can be configured in Plasma's notification
    settings, e.g. when the current note was modified externally while QOwnNotes was in
    the background
  - KDE builds use the PlasmaActivities library for the KDE Plasma activity integration,
    so activities are loaded without blocking, while older activity managers and other
    desktops keep using the existing implementation
  - KDE builds can use an installed KDE color scheme for the user interface, which can be
    selected in the Interface settings, while the system palette stays the default
  - When QOwnNotes is started again while it is already running, or by a global shortcut of
    the desktop portal, its window is now raised with the activation token of the launch on
    Wayland, and with the startup notification ID on X11 in KDE builds
  - KDE builds can send note files to installed targets like KDE Connect or email with
    the new Send note to menus in the Note menu and the note list context menu
  - Notes of a running QOwnNotes can be found in KDE Plasma's KRunner search by their name
